### 设计完成报告

所有家具电商网站（Furniro）的设计与原型连线任务已全部在 assigned Figma 文件的 **03 · Workspace** 页面中完成。

---

#### 1. 交付文件与 Workspace 信息
- **Figma 文件 URL**: [https://www.figma.com/design/lyAJXJy8GatyIPzWRh2m00/](https://www.figma.com/design/lyAJXJy8GatyIPzWRh2m00/)
- **03 · Workspace Page ID**: `15:2`

---

#### 2. 交付的 9 个标准 Frame 列表与 ID

1. **`01_Home`** (Node ID: `18:2`):
   - Header (Logo + 导航 + 图标)
   - Hero Section ("New Arrival", "Discover Our New Collection", "BUY NOW")
   - Browse The Range (Dining, Living, Bedroom)
   - Our Products (8款产品卡片，Leviosa 卡片处于 Hover 悬停态，包含 Add to cart / Share / Compare / Like)
   - Inspiration ("50+ Beautiful rooms inspiration", "01 — Bed Room", "Inner Peace", 轮播指示器)
   - Share your setup (#FurniroFurniture 9图宫格)
   - Footer

2. **`02_Shop`** (Node ID: `20:11`):
   - Page Banner & Breadcrumb (Home › Shop)
   - Toolbar (Filter, Grid/List 切换, 结果数, Show 16, Sort by)
   - Products (16款产品卡片，Leviosa 悬停态)
   - Pagination (1 · 2 · 3 · Next)
   - Features Strip (High Quality, Warranty Protection, Free Shipping, 24 / 7 Support)
   - Footer

3. **`03_Product`** (Node ID: `21:27`):
   - Breadcrumb (Home › Shop › Asgaard sofa)
   - Gallery (主图 + 4张缩略图)
   - Product Details (标题、价格 Rs. 250,000.00、4.7星级 204条评价、短描述)
   - Options (Size L/XL/XS选L，Color紫/黑/金)
   - Purchase (数量步进器 `- 1 +`、"Add To Cart"按钮、"+ Compare"按钮)
   - Meta (SKU SS001, Category Sofas, Tags, 社媒分享)
   - Tabs (Description 2段文字、Photo_Cloud_Sofa_1 & 2，Additional Info, Reviews [204])
   - Related Products (4款相关产品 + Show More)

4. **`04_Cart_Drawer`** (Node ID: `21:212`):
   - 背景为浅色蒙版覆盖的 03_Product 页面
   - 抽屉侧滑栏 ("Shopping Cart", 关闭按钮, Asgaard sofa `1 x Rs. 250,000.00`, 移除图标, Subtotal Rs. 250,000.00)
   - 底部操作按钮 ("Cart", "Checkout", "Comparison")

5. **`05_Comparison`** (Node ID: `22:58`):
   - Banner & Breadcrumb (Home › Comparison)
   - 比对栏 ("Go to Product page for more Products" + "View More"、Asgaard Sofa 卡片与评分、Outdoor Sofa Set 卡片与评分、"Add A Product" 下拉菜单)
   - 详细规格对比表 (分组：General, Product, Dimensions, Warranty，逐行双值对比)
   - 底部各产品 "Add To Cart" 按钮
   - Features Strip & Footer

6. **`06_Cart`** (Node ID: `23:78`):
   - Banner & Breadcrumb (Home › Cart)
   - Cart Table (列：Product, Price, Quantity, Subtotal；Asgaard sofa 行与 Icon_Delete)
   - Cart Totals (Subtotal Rs. 250,000.00, Total Rs. 250,000.00, "Check Out" 按钮)
   - Features Strip & Footer

7. **`07_Checkout`** (Node ID: `24:88`):
   - Banner & Breadcrumb (Home › Checkout)
   - Billing details 表单 (First/Last Name, Company, Country: Sri Lanka, Street, City, Province: Western Province, ZIP, Phone, Email, Additional info)
   - Order summary (Asgaard sofa x 1, Subtotal Rs. 250,000.00, Total Rs. 250,000.00)
   - Payment options (Direct Bank Transfer 选中及说明，Cash On Delivery，隐私政策文本)
   - "Place order" 按钮
   - Features Strip & Footer

8. **`08_Contact`** (Node ID: `25:99`):
   - Banner & Breadcrumb (Home › Contact)
   - Intro ("Get In Touch With Us")
   - Contact details (Address, Phone, Working Time 及图标)
   - Form (Your name, Email address, Subject, Message, "Submit" 按钮)
   - Features Strip & Footer

9. **`09_Blog`** (Node ID: `26:111`):
   - Banner & Breadcrumb (Home › Blog)
   - Posts 列表 (3篇文章，包含封面图、Admin/Date/Tag 元信息、标题、摘要及 "Read more")
   - Sidebar (搜索框、Categories 统计、Recent Posts 5篇带缩略图)
   - Pagination (1 · 2 · 3 · Next)
   - Features Strip & Footer

---

#### 3. 完成的原型交互连线 (Prototype Connections)
- `01_Home` ➔ `02_Shop` (通过 Header Nav "Shop" / Hero "BUY NOW" / "Show More")
- `01_Home` ➔ `03_Product` (点击任何产品卡片)
- `01_Home` ➔ `05_Comparison` (点击 Leviosa 悬停卡片上的 Compare)
- `01_Home` ➔ `06_Cart` (点击 Header 购物车图标)
- `01_Home` ➔ `08_Contact` (点击 Header Nav "Contact")
- `01_Home` ➔ `09_Blog` (点击 Footer 链接 "Blog")
- `02_Shop` ➔ `03_Product` (点击产品卡片) / `05_Comparison` (Leviosa Compare) / `01_Home` / `06_Cart`
- `03_Product` ➔ `04_Cart_Drawer` (点击 "Add To Cart")
- `03_Product` ➔ `05_Comparison` (点击 "+ Compare")
- `04_Cart_Drawer` ➔ `06_Cart` ("Cart") / `07_Checkout` ("Checkout") / `05_Comparison` ("Comparison") / `03_Product` (关闭按钮)
- `05_Comparison` ➔ `02_Shop` ("View More") / `06_Cart` ("Add To Cart")
- `06_Cart` ➔ `07_Checkout` ("Check Out") / `03_Product` (点击商品名)
- `08_Contact` & `09_Blog` ➔ `01_Home` (导航链接)
